children: Several victims have been reported following a shooting in the early morning at an event in Switzerland, local police said on Sunday.

Cantonal police in Aargau said a large scale operation was underway and they appealed to the public for any film or pictures of the incident, which the mass market Blick tabloid said had occurred at a rave party.
